description: This file defines a generic class 'StorageDataSetGenericHuge' used for testing storage functionalities in Orleans framework. It provides test data and iterators for test cases involving large data sets.

classes.name: StorageDataSetGenericHuge
classes.description: A generic test data generator class for storage tests, generating large data sets with different test cases.

methods.name: GetTestData
methods.description: Returns a tuple containing test data including grain type, grain id, and grain state, based on the test number.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Provides an enumerator over test case indices.
